unit: JPY 100 million (MoF ITS week.csv); CHF in the source unit already stored
source: Source: Ministry of Finance Japan, International Transactions in Securities

method.flows: Fable [PROV] uncalibrated (R12), kept until the GATE act. States on flow_jpy only, from pct52 of sum4 over 52 publications, 2 consecutive publications to enter and to exit, first vintage value (no repaint). VOTE=0 shadow; not in blocked_entry.
method.release: Signed rule: the week is Sun–Sat and MoF publishes on the Thursday after week_end, or on Friday when that Thursday is a Japanese national holiday (Cabinet Office, substitutes and citizens' holidays included). STALE from that calendar date + 1 day with no new row; the state is not classified. The published MoF release schedule also moves some Fridays when an earlier weekday is a holiday, and it combines some weeks (2026-10-01, 2027-01-07); those shifts are not applied.

coverage.CHF: SNB sight deposits already in history/chf (snbgwdchfsgw TG, GI, UEB); value, sum4, z52 only
coverage.USD: NA — Fed custody is not among the captured H.4.1 series (WALCL, TREAST, WSHOMCB, WLCFLPCL, WTREGEN, WRESBAL); no new source added
